title: Non-anchor position period prediction v36
rationale: This lane does not search candidate words, key material, routed fragments, or public anchor-derived additive spans. It pre-registers absolute-position residue classes as a structural prediction before any new scoring, and it can only become evidence if later independently documented non-anchor observations land in the declared classes under null controls.
prediction_target: Future independently sourced non-anchor K4 position observations should be enriched in one or more predeclared one-based absolute-position residue classes from the registered period family at a rate exceeding seeded null, best-of-period, and multiple-comparison controls.
discovery_inputs: Predeclared period family from the registered structural-model lane
One-based K4 absolute position numbers only
Residue classes emitted before observing any new source-backed position evidence
evaluation_inputs: Future independently sourced non-anchor K4 position observations
Source-reviewed observation files that were not used to choose the period family or residues
Position-only scoring target, not public anchor additive fragments
controls: best-of-period null control across the registered period family
multiple-comparison correction across declared residue classes
promotion blocked unless held-out independent observations beat both match-count and adjusted pattern controls
